text.3:40: He said: My Lord! How can I have a son when age hath overtaken me already and my wife is barren? (The angel) answered: So (it will be). Allah doeth what He will.
text.12:19: And there came a caravan, and they sent their waterdrawer. He let down his pail (into the pit). He said: Good luck! Here is a youth. And they hid him as a treasure, and Allah was Aware of what they did.
text.15:53: They said: Be not afraid! Lo! we bring thee good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom.
text.18:74: So they twain journeyed on till, when they met a lad, he slew him. (Moses) said: What! Hast thou slain an innocent soul who hath slain no man? Verily thou hast done a horrid thing.
text.18:80: And as for the lad, his parents were believers and we feared lest he should oppress them by rebellion and disbelief.
text.18:82: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure belonging to them, and their father had been righteous, and thy Lord intended that they should come to their full strength and should bring forth their treasure as a mercy from their Lord; and I did it not upon my own command. Such is the interpretation of that wherewith thou couldst not bear.
text.19:7: (It was said unto him): O Zachariah! Lo! We bring thee tidings of a son whose name is John; we have given the same name to none before (him).
text.19:8: He said: My Lord! How can I have a son when my wife is barren and I have reached infirm old age?
text.19:19: He said: I am only a messenger of thy Lord, that I may bestow on thee a faultless son.
text.19:20: She said: How can I have a son when no mortal hath touched me, neither have I been unchaste?
text.37:101: So We gave him tidings of a gentle son.
text.51:28: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.
text.52:24: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls.
